knownSourceAnomalies.description: CAPS prints no statement codes. The same Skill wording repeats across sub-strands, terms, and grades; each occurrence is scoped by its Grade, Term, Skill Area, and Sub-strand and must not be treated as a global identifier.
knownSourceAnomalies.requiredDisclosure: Code search is unavailable; text and hierarchy context are used for retrieval.

notes: This CAPS English Home Language Grades R-3 curriculum is English-only for KG extraction. Do not create bilingual pairs, translations, or cross-language equivalents. statementTypes.description: Visible CAPS Foundation Phase grade (Grade R, 1, 2 or 3), printed in each REQUIREMENTS PER TERM table banner as 'GRADE <n> HOME LANGUAGE ENGLISH'; a root-level Standard Grouping under the framework.
Visible TERM label in a REQUIREMENTS PER TERM table banner, scoped under the active Grade.

Visible skill-area label in a REQUIREMENTS PER TERM table banner, scoped under the active Grade and Term. Grade R uses Listening and Speaking (Oral), Emergent Reading and Emergent Writing; Grades 1-3 use Listening and Speaking (Oral), Reading and Phonics, and Writing.

statementTypes.description: Sub-strand heading printed inside the CONTENT/CONCEPTS/SKILLS body of a REQUIREMENTS PER TERM table, before its ASSESSMENT row, that groups the bulleted learner statements after it (for example Phonics, Shared Reading or Handwriting); scoped under the table's Grade, Term and Skill Area. A Standard Grouping between Skill Area and Skill.

Official CAPS learner requirement: one bulleted statement in the CONTENT/CONCEPTS/SKILLS body of a REQUIREMENTS PER TERM table (or its continuation rows), scoped under the active Grade, Term and Skill Area and the Sub-strand heading printed above it. CAPS prints no codes for these statements.
